title: En-route Frequency Handoff — Brisbane to Sydney Centre

briefing.summary: You are cruising at FL220 on Brisbane Centre, approaching the Brisbane–Sydney FIR boundary. Brisbane Centre is about to hand you off to Sydney Centre.

transmission.speaker: atc
transmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, Brisbane Centre, contact Sydney Centre one three four decimal eight five.

transmission.speaker: pilot
transmission.text: Sydney Centre one three four decimal eight five, Mike X-ray Golf.

question.prompt: Brisbane Centre has just told you to contact Sydney Centre on 134.85. What is the correct acknowledgement?

options.text: Roger Sydney one three four eight five, Mike X-ray Golf.
Sydney Centre one three four decimal eight five, Mike X-ray Golf.
Mike X-ray Golf, switching to Sydney.
Going over to Sydney Centre, Mike X-ray Golf.

question.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4 frequency-change readback: read back the receiving station and the full frequency (including 'decimal'), then your callsign. "Roger" alone is not a frequency readback.

transmission.speaker: pilot
transmission.text: Sydney Centre, Mike X-ray Golf, flight level two two zero.

question.prompt: You've switched to 134.85. What is the correct initial call to Sydney Centre?

options.text: Sydney Centre, Mike X-ray Golf with you, level two two zero.
Sydney, Mike X-ray Golf, cruising FL two two zero.
Sydney Centre, Mike X-ray Golf, flight level two two zero.
Sydney Centre, this is Mike X-ray Golf checking in at FL two two zero.

question.explanation: AIP GEN 3.4 initial call: addressed station, your callsign, current level ("flight level two two zero"). Avoid filler like "with you" or "checking in" — they aren't standard phraseology.

transmission.speaker: atc
transmission.text: Mike X-ray Golf, Sydney Centre, identified, maintain flight level two two zero.

transmission.speaker: pilot
transmission.text: Maintain flight level two two zero, Mike X-ray Golf.

question.prompt: Sydney Centre has identified you and instructed "maintain flight level two two zero". What's the required readback?

options.text: Maintain flight level two two zero, Mike X-ray Golf.

question.explanation: MATS Part 4 mandatory readback items include any level instruction. Read back the instruction verbatim and end with your callsign.

refs.note: Source/access date 2026-06-09. Frequency change readback and initial-contact format.
Source/access date 2026-06-09. Mandatory readback items: levels, headings, speeds, runway, QNH, squawk.
